environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Application Gateway with no WAF policy attached. Container runs as root with default network access. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. Application is directly accessible via public IP on port 443 with TLS termination at the gateway.

config.gateway: Azure Application Gateway (Standard_v2, no WAF SKU)
config.network: public-facing, no NSG restrictions on HTTP
